commits.title: fix(coding-agent): stop listing MCP resources when connecting
commits.finding: Connecting and list/status no longer enumerate resources or templates; capability availability is reported instead. PiSharp still lists both during connect and on list_changed.

commits.resolution: MCP connections and resource-change notifications no longer enumerate resources/templates. Capability status reports resources without counts; shared resource tools list only on demand. The fail-first startup log now shows no listings until requested, and the notification scenario retains tool refresh plus fresh resource/template results. Seven current-Pi real-stdio scenarios match connection/on-demand request counts; CLI status capability checks pass.

commits.title: fix(mcp,coding-agent): accept any JSON value as tool structuredContent
commits.finding: structuredContent accepts arrays, null, strings, numbers and booleans; absent-schema Codemode type is unknown. PiSharp schema requires object and does not render structured-only results as model text.
commits.implementation_plan: Verify SDK deserialization of arbitrary JSON, broaden the wrapper schema, preserve explicit null, and add the JSON fallback for empty model content.
commits.differential_plan: Replay the five upstream scalar/array/null vectors through real HTTP or stdio and nested Codemode.
commits.resolution: MCP script results preserve arrays, explicit null, strings, numbers and booleans, including missing content normalized to an empty array. Empty model content falls back to pretty JSON and undeclared structuredContent accepts any JSON value. Native SDK session responses retain field presence before typed block conversion, avoiding nullable-deserialization loss. Seven real-stdio Pi comparisons match complete script JSON, model text and error state; nested null/array Codemode paths and schema validation pass. The full working-tree suite passes 1418/1418, zero skips; official MCP retains 261 passing checks and eight classified failures with no regressions.

commits.title: fix(tui): let unhandled wheel input scroll the transcript under a focused overlay
commits.finding: Unhandled wheel input scrolls the transcript below a focused overlay. PiSharp routes mouse input through concrete dialogs and selection lists; no broad current overlay differential proves all paths.
commits.implementation_plan: Characterize wheel dispatch for input and mouse-aware overlays and route only unhandled wheel input to the transcript.
commits.differential_plan: PTY fixture with a long transcript and focused input overlay; compare viewport and untouched editor input.

commits.title: feat(coding-agent): show elapsed and total time on codemode rows
commits.finding: Codemode emits an initial progress update and shows Elapsed while running and recorded Took on completion/reload. PiSharp lacks the timer contract.
commits.implementation_plan: Use shared tool timing state with initial progress, final monotonic duration and redraw disposal.
commits.differential_plan: Deterministic renderer clock vectors plus PTY nested-call, no-call, failure, cancellation and restored-result checkpoints.

commits.title: fix(mcp): do not retry cancelled HTTP requests after an authorization refresh
commits.finding: Calls cancelled or timed out during shared OAuth recovery never dispatch after refresh; surviving requests still proceed. PiSharp forwards tokens through SDK handlers but lacks this race proof.
commits.implementation_plan: Exercise the real SDK transport recovery race and adapt its boundary if a settled request is dispatched.
commits.differential_plan: Gate one shared refresh, abort one call, time out one and retain one; only the survivor reaches the server.
commits.resolution: Canceled/deadline-expired MCP requests settle before a shared OAuth refresh finishes and never replay afterwards; the surviving caller proceeds across one grant without retiring the connection. A bounded cloned grant persists rotation and client/issuer binding independently of canceled callers. Request-scoped challenge attribution prevents an SDK metadata race from refreshing a newly saved token for an old challenge. Exact-lease removal precedes unlock and failed persistence settles. The real connection race failed first; null-expiry, subsequent valid refresh and failed-write controls now pass. Production Pi OAuth/HTTP and native PiSharp SDK comparisons match caller settlement, executed names, one grant, surviving text and preserved tokens/client. Full suite 1451/1451, zero skips, zero-warning build; official MCP has no regressions against eight classified failures. Close-during-refresh and public exception-shape parity are not established by this slice.

commits.title: fix(coding-agent): warn and exit non-zero in print mode on truncated response
commits.finding: Text print mode preserves partial stdout but warns on stderr and exits 1 for a final length stop. PiSharp print execution does not handle output-token-limit finish reason.
commits.implementation_plan: Propagate the final finish reason to print-mode exit handling without affecting interactive/JSON modes.
commits.differential_plan: Paired print CLI processes with a deterministic length-stop provider; assert stdout, stderr and exit status.
commits.resolution: Text print mode preserves partial stdout, emits Pi's exact output-token-limit warning to stderr and exits 1 when the final provider response finishes with length. Successful later continuations override earlier length stops, empty responses still warn, and interactive/JSON modes retain their behavior. One process test failed first; all 25 print/transcript checks pass. Four real Pi/PiSharp CLI scenarios match text-mode stdout/stderr/exit/request count and bounded JSON-mode text/exit behavior with compaction/retry disabled. PiSharp's different JSON envelope and absent public stop reason remain explicitly open protocol requirements.

commits.title: fix(coding-agent): retry transient Windows EPERM when acquiring auth lock

commits.implementation_plan: Inspect native credential write/lock semantics and add bounded transient Windows retries only at the equivalent acquisition boundary.
commits.differential_plan: Injected native-error regression vectors, cancellation and persistent permission failures; native Windows execution remains platform-unavailable on Linux.

commits.title: fix(ai): drop images from Anthropic error tool results

Live MAF results carry request-only attribution so only failed tool attachments are removed, unrelated user images remain, and the persisted contract is unchanged. commits.title: fix(coding-agent): restore active tools on session resume (#10887)
commits.finding: Default-tool resumes restore transcript loadouts with +/- modifiers; explicit tools and exclusions override restoration. PiSharp restores saved loadouts unconditionally, so explicit/modifier behavior needs reconciliation.
commits.implementation_plan: Resolve resume policy in CLI composition and pass the evidenced loadout to the shared runtime, preserving branch/reload semantics.
commits.differential_plan: Paired persisted-session resume vectors for defaults, inactive extensions, explicit allowlist, no-tools, exclusions and +/- modifiers.
commits.resolution: Default selections keep all built-ins available and restore recorded loadouts from native records or Pi system declarations, including empty and updated sets. CLI +/- modifiers apply in order to restored names; explicit selections and disabled-tool modes take precedence, and exclusions remain enforced. Selection provenance survives settings application/reload; native runtime explicit selections also override saved tools. Five behavioral cases failed first. All ten real Pi SDK/PiSharp composition scenarios match exact active sets, including fresh-session extension defaults; delayed-registration differential remains matched. The full suite passes 1448/1448 with zero skips and a zero-warning build. Broader allowlist patterns, provider-wire order and SDK surface parity remain open.

commits.title: fix(coding-agent): keep codemode cancellation prompt and bounded
commits.finding: Abort/timeout/close settle promptly without waiting on worker exit, retain partial output and account two shared worker slots until actual exit. PiSharp kills a separate Node process then awaits exit without a bound, has no global admission limit and discards cancelled output.
commits.implementation_plan: Use process-native shutdown with bounded settlement, shared admission released on actual exit, retained partial output and first-terminal-result ordering.
commits.differential_plan: Real spinning/non-interruptible worker tests, delayed exit, cancellation/timeout, capacity burst, replacement and process exit.
